findings.message: probe_arm to probe_key: drawn 0.20 mm apart. Built from printed and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.20 +/-0.29 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 23.8% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.8%; limit 1%).

x_beam to x_endstop_nut_1: drawn 0.35 mm apart. Built from extrusion and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.35 +/-0.30 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 13.2% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.6%; limit 1%).

extruder to x_belt_block_screw_0: drawn 0.20 mm apart. Built from purchased and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.20 +/-0.16 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 11.1% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.6%; limit 1%).

extruder to x_belt_block_screw_1: drawn 0.20 mm apart. Built from purchased and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.20 +/-0.15 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 9.6% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.5%; limit 1%).

x_carriage to x_belt_block: drawn 0.50 mm apart. Built from purchased and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.50 +/-0.26 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 2.7% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.3%; limit 1%).

Bed probe 'bed_probe': extruder (al6061) is drawn 0.05 mm outside the sensor's metal-free zone (55 mm diameter, 22 mm behind the face). As built the gap is 0.05 +/-0.58 mm (one standard deviation): the part is inside the zone in 44.5% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.9%; limit 1%).

extruder_screw_0 to part_duct: drawn 0.55 mm apart. Built from purchased and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.55 +/-0.23 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 0.97% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.18%; an error above 1%).

extruder to part_duct: drawn 0.50 mm apart. Built from purchased and printed parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.50 +/-0.17 mm (one standard deviation) and closes in 0.10% of 3000 simulated builds (standard error 0.06%; an error above 1%).

x_rail to x_endstop_screw_1: drawn 0.60 mm apart. Built from purchased and purchased parts through the joints between them the gap is 0.60 +/-0.18 mm (one standard deviation) and closed in none of 3000 simulated builds, but its spread puts it at about 0.0004 of builds (normal estimate; an error above 1%).

Bed probe 'bed_probe': a unit at the short end of its spread (switching distance 3 mm on aluminium (OMRON E2E data sheet CSM_E2E_DS_E_12_4, chart 'Influence of Sensing Object Size and Material' (p.18): REFERENCE value read by eye (+/-0.15 mm) for a 1 mm aluminium plate; about 3.3 at 15-20 mm plate side, falling to 3.0 at 60 mm. A 6 mm bed plate 200 mm square is outside the chart), +/-10% unit to unit (from its rating

Bed probe 'bed_probe' is offset (-36.5, 13.01) mm from the nozzle and kept 24 mm inside the plate edge, so strips of the print area are never probed: {'x_low': np.float64(4.0), 'x_high': 36.5, 'y_low': 13.01, 'y_high': np.float64(4.0)} (mm wide; print area declared: design.printer['print_area'] = 180 x 180 mm, centred on the plate). The firmware holds the nearest measured value there.
Heater 'extruder': a shorted MOSFET is survived only because the firmware drops the supply relay (peak 282 degC). There is no cut-off that works if the controller has also hung.

The only assembly order found installs something before the part that supports it (around ['bed_carrier', 'electronics', 'extruder', 'extruder_screw_0', 'frame_bot_back', 'frame_bot_right']); it would need holding in place.

A 1 kg print at the worst corner of the print area lowers the print surface there by 0.092 mm (bonded joints 0.067, screw-only joints 0.092; of which guides and nut 0.004), more than 0.1 of a 0.2 mm layer (0.020 mm). The bed is levelled and meshed empty, so neither sees it.

Test print: Corners and seams bulge up to 0.35 mm (material keeps flowing while the nozzle slows; size depends on the 32 ms extruder lag (direct drive, 0.4 mm nozzle: factory pressure-advance values (fitted_parameters.json: extruder_lag_s), range 0.02 to 0.058 s)).
